title: Smart Data Models - UNTP - DigitalProductPassport
description: https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/untp/DigitalProductPassport . A digital Product Passport (DPP) credential. A W3C Verifiable Credential (VCDM 2.0) envelope whose credentialSubject is a Product (https://untp.unece.org/docs/specification/DigitalProductPassport/). In this candidate, the envelope (issuer, validity, credential status, render/issuing-software metadata) is kept as its own entity with a `product` Relationship to a separately-addressable Product entity, rather than inlining the full Product schema -- see standard-metadata.yaml.

id.description: A unique identifier (URI) assigned to this verifiable credential.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DigitalProductPassport'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

vcContext.description: Property. The W3C Verifiable Credential JSON-LD context array for this credential (e.g. ["https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/v2", "https://vocabulary.uncefact.org/untp/0.8.0/context/"]). Named `vcContext` here (instead of the source's own `@context`) to avoid colliding with NGSI-LD's own reserved top-level `@context` mechanism -- this property holds the W3C VC context array as plain data, it is not this NGSI-LD entity's own linked-data context.

issuer.description: Property. The organisation that is the issuer of this VC. Note that the "id" property MUST be a W3C DID.  Other identifiers such as tax registration numbers can be listed in the "otherIdentifiers" property.

id.description: The W3C DID of the issuer - should be a did:web or did:webvh

name.description: The name of the issuer person or organisation

id.description: Globally unique identifier of this party. Typically represented as a URI identifierScheme/Identifier URI

name.description: Legal registered name of this party.

registeredId.description: The registration number (alphanumeric) of the Party within the register. Unique within the register.

issuerAlsoKnownAs.description: An optional list of other registered identifiers for this credential issuer

validFrom.description: Property. The date and time from which the credential is valid.

validUntil.description: Property. The expiry date (if applicable) of this verifiable credential.

name.description: Property. Name of this verifiable credential instance (eg the title of a digital product passport, facility record, lifecycle event, or conformity credential)

credentialStatus.description: Property. A W3C VCDM2.0 compliant object containing credential status information.

type.description: The type of status list - must be set to "The type property MUST be BitstringStatusListEntry."

id.description: optional identifier of this status list entry.

statusPurpose.description: Status purpose drawn from a standard list but extensible as per w3c bitstring status list specification.

statusListIndex.description: The statusListIndex property MUST be an arbitrary size integer greater than or equal to 0, expressed as a string in base 10. The value identifies the position of the status of the verifiable credential.

statusListCredential.description: The statusListCredential property MUST be a URL to a verifiable credential. When the URL is dereferenced, the resulting verifiable credential MUST have type property that includes the BitstringStatusListCredential value.

items.description: A single template format focused render method where the content/media type decision becomes secondary (and is expressed separately).See https://github.com/w3c-ccg/vc-render-method/issues/9

name.description: Human facing display name for selection

mediaQuery.description: Media query as defined in https://www.w3.org/TR/mediaqueries-4/

template.description: An inline template field for use cases where remote retrieval of a render method is suboptimal

mediaType.description: media type of the rendered output (eg text/html)

digestMultibase.description: Used for resource integrity and/or validation of the inline `template`

renderMethod.description: Property. Human rendering information for this credential. An array of render methods (eg RenderTemplate2024) that may be used to display the credential.

issuingSoftware.description: Property. Optional metadata identifying the software product (and its vendor) that issued this credential. Useful for vendor traceability and conformity testing. Issuers MAY omit this property.

id.description: A resolvable identifier for the specific version of the software product that issued this credential.

name.description: The name of the software product that issued this credential.

version.description: The version of the software product that issued this credential.

vendor.description: The vendor of the software product that issued this credential.

id.description: The decentralised identifier (DID) or other resolvable identifier of the software vendor.

name.description: The name of the software vendor.

product.description: Relationship. The product that is the subject of this digital product passport. Links to a Product entity. Replaces the source schema's inline `credentialSubject` ($ref to the Product definition) with a Relationship to a separately-addressable Product entity, per this candidate's two-entity architecture -- see standard-metadata.yaml.
